snippet.title: GO GO, GROOVE GHOUL! - RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Links to the game:
https://lua-computa.itch.io/go-go-groove-ghoul
https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/1002501


Go Go Groove Ghoul is a bombastic arcade game where you play as a ghost! You must possess the enemies in every level and try to get them to kill themselves with any nearby hazards in order to progress in each level. Rack up big combos, beware the timer and fly through the air with style!

There are 4 levels here to playthrough currently, each with unique theming and mechanics. There's also a "secret" hardmode that can be activated via pressing the 9 key in the level select, which adds an extra layer of chaos to the stages. You can also pimp out your ghoul in the shop with several skins to purchase!

I started with project all the way in December last year, with me wanting to get it out within December/January. However I kinda fell off the project and then worked on it very inconsistently until like September and August. Now it's finally here for October! How fitting given the ghostly theming of this project! Happy Halloween, fellas!!!
